verses.1: And the Philistines gathered all their camps together. Israel, on the other hand, gathered its camps near Jerusalem.
verses.2: And the soldiers of Philistia cross over to Moab, along with thousands of people. David and his men also cross over in the opposite direction, along with the serpent.
verses.3: And the priests of Phalashit said, “What kind of people are these Israelites?” Achish replied to them, “This is David, a servant of Saul, the king of Israel. He was with me for those days and years. But I couldn’t find any good qualities in him from the day he fell until today.”
verses.4: And the princes of Philistia scoffed at him. They said to him, “Return to your place, where you were assigned. Do not come down with us into battle. Do not become our enemy in battle. This will please our lords.”
verses.5: Behold, this is David, who will be answered in his afflictions. They will say, “Shaul struck the thousands, and David struck the ten thousand.”
verses.6: And Achiš called to David, and said to him, “May the LORD live! You are indeed a good man in my eyes. Come to me in the valley, for I have not found any evil in you since the day you came to me until today. But in the eyes of the scribes, you are not a good man at all.”
verses.7: And now, go again in peace, and do not do anything bad in the eyes of the Philistines.
verses.8: And David said to Achish, “What have I done? What have you found among your servants since I was with you until today? I will not go and fight against the enemies of my Lord.”
verses.9: And Achan said to David, “I know that you are good in my eyes, as God has blessed you. But the soldiers of Philistia said, ‘We will not go into battle with you.’”
verses.10: And now, let there be light in the morning. And let your servants who have come with you be able to see and be guided by light, so that they may go on their way.
verses.11: And David and his men went out in the morning to return to the land of Philistines. And the Philistines rose up against them.
